# ArcFace ResNet-50

Embedding · `arcface_resnet50_112x112` · DX-APP C++ example

Embedding model, evaluated on LFW.

**Input** 112 × 112 × 3 · **Dataset** LFW · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/face_recognition/arcface/arcface_resnet50_112x112/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models arcface_r50
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target arcface_resnet50_112x112_sync   # once
./bin/arcface_resnet50_112x112_sync \
  -m assets/models/arcface_resnet50_112x112.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/face_pair
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/face_recognition/arcface/arcface_resnet50_112x112/arcface_resnet50_112x112_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/arcface_resnet50_112x112.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/face_pair
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Accuracy |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 96.98 |
| Q-Lite | 97.05 (+0.07) |
| Q-Pro | 97.07 (+0.09) |
